title: Mille
wikitext:
Mille has been playing QuakeWorld on and off since the late 90's. He's had long breaks during this time and the last break lasted 15+ years. Recently he found his way back to the game thanks to a christmas card he received in 2024 from someone in the community. Started playing again in januari 2025.

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/mille_qw/

Youtube: https://youtube.com/@mille_qw
